content.text:
Fourteen files in the repo use `LoadingSkeleton`. Each is a Next.js `loading.tsx` file that imports it from `@/components/loading-skeleton` and renders it. A search of the repo, excluding `node_modules`, `.next` and `.git`, found no test files that reference it. Some pass a `rows` prop (2, 3 or 4) and the rest use the default.

The definition file `web/src/components/loading-skeleton.tsx` defines it but doesn't call it, so I left it out.

<files>
web/src/app/loading.tsx
web/src/app/tuna/loading.tsx
web/src/app/auth/auth-code-error/loading.tsx
web/src/app/verify/email/confirm/loading.tsx
web/src/app/communities/loading.tsx
web/src/app/verify/email/loading.tsx
web/src/app/profile/loading.tsx
web/src/app/user/[handle]/loading.tsx
web/src/app/me/loading.tsx
web/src/app/communities/new/loading.tsx
web/src/app/community/[slug]/loading.tsx
web/src/app/global/loading.tsx
web/src/app/claim/loading.tsx
</files>

Correction: that's 13 files, not 14. The list above is the accurate one.
